summary: Static architecture: Astro with no backend and no database on Firebase Hosting in us-central1. Driven mainly by project.type and scale.workload; $0/month.

architecture.justification: No server-side logic or stored user data is needed (project.type is content_site, platforms include web), so the site is built ahead of time and served as static files.

alternatives.why_not: There is no server component to split or scale.
There is no server component to split or scale.
There is no server component to split or scale.

frontend.justification: Astro: content that rarely changes is best pre-built as static files; server rendering or pre-built pages serve search engines; suited to project.type content_site; free at the expected load; uses javascript, which the team already writes, for the 2-week MVP. Ships near-zero JavaScript by default, so pages stay light on slow networks.

alternatives.why_not: Eleventy scores lower on maintainability (3.7 against 4.0, priorities.maintainability is 3), which accounts for 1.0 of the 1.0-point gap.
Astro is preferred because content that rarely changes is best pre-built as static files.

tradeoffs: Not suited to highly interactive app-like screens

backend.justification: No server-side logic is needed: the site is pre-built and served as static files.

alternatives.why_not: No server-side logic is needed: the site is pre-built and served as static files.

database.justification: No stored user data; content lives in Git.

alternatives.why_not: No stored user data; content lives in Git.

hosting.justification: Firebase Hosting: built for static files with a global CDN; suited to project.type content_site; deploys straight from git, no pipeline to maintain; free at the expected load; quick to build with for a 2-week MVP. Global CDN with one-command deploys. Deployed in us-central1.

alternatives.why_not: Netlify and Firebase Hosting are about equal on the weighted score; Firebase Hosting is chosen on its free-tier terms (Spark plan: 10 GB storage and 360 MB/day transfer free); Netlify has Free plan: credit-based limits; check the current terms for commercial use.
GitHub Pages scores lower on security (3.0 against 4.0, priorities.security is 2), which accounts for 2.2 of the 3.8-point gap.

tradeoffs: Static/CDN only; dynamic code goes to Cloud Functions or Cloud Run
Edge delivery is not region pinned
Free tier limits apply: Spark plan: 10 GB storage and 360 MB/day transfer free.

supporting.justification: Firebase Hosting (CDN included with host): included with the hosting platform at no extra cost; suited to project.type content_site; free at the expected load; quick to build with for a 2-week MVP. No separate CDN to configure or pay for.

alternatives.why_not: Firebase Hosting (CDN included with host) is preferred because included with the hosting platform at no extra cost.
Google Cloud CDN scores lower on cost (0.0 against 5.0, priorities.cost is 5), which accounts for 27.8 of the 86.8-point gap.

alternatives.choice: AWS Amplify Hosting (CDN included with host)
alternatives.why_not: Excluded: is only available with its own hosting platform.

tradeoffs: Only available when Firebase Hosting is the host
Operations burden 4 of 5 with no devops engineer.

supporting.justification: GitHub Actions: suited to project.type content_site; widely used, with free minutes for small teams; free at the expected load; quick to build with for a 2-week MVP. Pipelines next to the code with a huge marketplace of actions.

alternatives.why_not: GitHub Actions is preferred because widely used, with free minutes for small teams.
Google Cloud Build: operations burden 4 of 5 with no devops engineer.

alternatives.choice: Host git integration (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages)
alternatives.why_not: Excluded: needs a host with its own build-from-git pipeline.

tradeoffs: Hosted runners are US based; self-hosted runners fix that
Free tier limits apply: Free: 2,000 minutes per month on private repos; unlimited on public.

assumptions: Priced for 3,000 monthly active users (the larger of users_at_launch and users_12_months), interpolated between list-price anchors in the knowledge base.
Prices are list prices of the cheapest region inside the chosen residency zone; taxes are excluded.
Database storage is priced for 1 GB (scale.data_volume_gb_12_months).
Firebase Hosting: free tier used at the low end (Spark plan: 10 GB storage and 360 MB/day transfer free)
GitHub Actions: free tier used at the low end (Free: 2,000 minutes per month on private repos; unlimited on public)
Payment gateway fees (about 2% per transaction), one-time costs, domain names and developer seats are not infrastructure and are excluded.

basis: peak_rps: 0.2 requests per second per concurrent user, derived
api_instances_at_peak: none to size, no server-side backend

warnings.message: The low end of the estimate relies on free tiers: Firebase Hosting (Spark plan: 10 GB storage and 360 MB/day transfer free); GitHub Actions (Free: 2,000 minutes per month on private repos; unlimited on public). Check them against the expected traffic.
